title: The Better Angels of Machine Personality: How Personality Relates to LLM Safety
findings: The paper's findings related to religion are indirect. It measures 'fairness' as a safety capability, partly by evaluating stereotypical biases about religion using the StereoSet dataset. The key finding is that certain personality traits in LLMs correlate with fairness performance. For example, models exhibiting more 'Sensing' (S) or 'Perceiving' (P) traits showed superior fairness performance. The paper does not provide a specific breakdown of results for religious stereotypes versus other types of bias.
